title: Submarines take evasive action from fast-closing underwater objects

tellings.quote: I've had several submarine officers come to me two uh and one listed and they all reported to me these instances where they were all of a sudden en encountering an object under a water that was closing rapidly

plain: A retired US Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says several submarine officers, plus one enlisted sailor, came to him with reports of sudden encounters with objects under the water that were closing on their submarines very fast, forcing them to take evasive action. He gives no time or place. If true, it would mean unknown craft are moving through the oceans at speeds the Navy cannot explain.
